name: eng-2195
title: Normalize imported node type formats for Obsidian filenames

prepare.why: the dev graph published a PK Note node type with Roam's bracketed format [[PKN]] - {content}, and one node, to the eng-2329-demo group
the vault has no PK Note type or note from an earlier import

apply.js: (async () => { await proof.obsidian.closeModals(); await proof.obsidian.removeFiles(proof.obsidian.importedFiles(['pk-2195-roam-note'])); await proof.obsidian.removeNodeTypes(['PK Note']); proof.obsidian.clearNotices(); })()

cases.title: A Roam format with brackets becomes a valid Obsidian format
cases.caption: Roam formats wrap the tag in double brackets, which Obsidian file names can't hold. Importing a Roam node type now stores its format as PKN, dash, content.

steps.why: open import the way a user would
wait for the shared nodes to load

do.js: proof.waitFor(() => /Successfully imported|Import completed/.test(proof.obsidian.notices()), { what: 'the import to finish', timeout: 30000 })

expect.js: proof.waitFor(() => { const type = proof.obsidian.nodeType('PK Note'); return type && type.format === 'PKN - {content}'; }, { what: 'PK Note with the format PKN - {content}', timeout: 20000 })

cases.title: The imported note's file is named from that format
cases.caption: So the imported note decorates as a normal file name: PKN, dash, Sleep improves memory.

expect.js: proof.assert(window.app.workspace.getActiveFile().basename === 'PKN - Sleep improves memory', 'The imported note is named ' + window.app.workspace.getActiveFile().basename + '.')
